instructions: Svatantrya Sanskrit reader — ChatGPT-first. START HERE: call scholar__readability_status (no args) for counts + per-work status, then scholar__search_texts (semantic, gate-filtered) or scholar__search_chunks (every layer, diacritics optional), then scholar__passage_evidence {work,target} for the hash-checked Sanskrit + editorial layers. scholar__list_works lists bundles — catalogue is not text. scholar__preview_read returns UNREVIEWED machine English with its rights caveat; never evidence. Withheld text states why (versions, trace verdicts, preview availability); never invent Sanskrit, a form not in the corpus does not render. Layers in plain words: draft-translation, literal-gloss (forks live here), argument-map, reading-translation, essence, register-render, final-translation, song; keys T1/L0/ARGMAP/L2/C1/C2/L3/L4 also work.
